selection: Each model/feature set independently tuned by inner AP; ties choose first candidate. Fixed 600 nnPU epochs; six PU bags.
lopo: nnPU full and mutation-only independently tuned on 16 remaining positives and fixed training-unlabelled set. Hold out fixed 10 percent of U as common test background; held positive never included as unlabelled. Compare all 17 held-positive ranks.
prior_sensitivity: nnPU full and mutation on first repeat outer folds; fixed priors .0005,.001,.003,.01,.03; L2 tuned within each outer training set. Secondary diagnostic, not model selection.
stability: Fit nnPU/GB/LightGBM full and nnPU mutation to same 16-positive deletion training sets; rank original U within fixed heldout U background. Top100 fractional tie weights and pairwise weighted Jaccard. Sensitivity to positive deletion, not independent biological replication.
reuse: Reuse complete checkpoint only when source hash matches plan; no original artifacts overwritten.
interpretation: Additional exploratory experiments on consumed data; no new independent test. No label expansion or external outcome tuning.
